games.centipede.subtitle: CENTIPEDE · 1980

games.galaxian.name: Galaxian

games.gun-fight.subtitle: GUN FIGHT · 1975

games.lunar-lander.name: Lunar Lander
games.lunar-lander.subtitle: LUNAR LANDER · 1979
games.missile-command.description: Defend six cities with three missile batteries. Includes missile trails, octagonal explosions, bombers, and changing wave colors.
games.missile-command.name: Missile Command
games.missile-command.subtitle: MISSILE COMMAND · 1980

games.pong.name: Pong
games.pong.subtitle: PONG · 1972
games.snake.description: Eat, grow, and keep moving. Guide the snake to food, avoid walls and yourself, and see how far you can go.
games.snake.name: Snake
games.snake.subtitle: SNAKE

games.space-invaders.subtitle: SPACE INVADERS · 1978

games.metal-slug.name: Metal Slug
games.metal-slug.subtitle: Three-mission run and gun · Phaser port
games.metal-slug.description: A Phaser run and gun rebuilt with MetalSlugClone artwork and sound. Cross the beach, night wreckage and temple; use a pistol, heavy machine gun, melee and grenades against soldiers, crabs, helicopters and three bosses. Supports keyboard, gamepads, touch controls, pause and saved progress. Level layouts and boss attacks are rearranged.

games.bomberman.name: Bomberman
games.bomberman.subtitle: BOMBERMAN CLONE
games.bomberman.description: Place bombs to destroy bricks and enemies. Collect upgrades for blast range, movement speed and bomb capacity. Chase a kill record solo or battle a friend locally.
games.bomberman.p2Controls: Player 2: move / place bomb (also controls P1 in solo mode)
games.bomberman.restart: Enter or Play Again to restart
games.gold-miner.name: Gold Miner
games.gold-miner.subtitle: Time your hook. Strike it rich.
games.gold-miner.description: Swing your claw and reel in gold, diamonds and mystery bags. Heavy treasure takes longer and rocks pay little. Reach the target in 60 seconds, then buy dynamite, strength tonic and diamond polish for the next mine.

games.sokoban.name: Sokoban
games.sokoban.subtitle: A little push. A lot of thought.
games.sokoban.description: Play 185 community-designed puzzles by David W. Skinner: Microban II (135 levels) and Sasquatch (50 levels). Push every crate onto a goal. Choose any level, undo a wrong turn, and resume your saved puzzle. Each unique cleared level earns 100 points.

games.fireboy-watergirl.subtitle: Forest Temple · Better together
games.fireboy-watergirl.description: Control Fireboy and Watergirl together. Collect matching gems, jump over dangerous pools, and use crates, pressure plates and levers to open gates. Fireboy cannot touch water; Watergirl cannot touch fire. Avoid poison and reach both exits before time runs out across three temples.

games.cut-the-rope.name: Cut the Rope
games.cut-the-rope.subtitle: One candy · twelve puzzles

games.petConnect.subtitle: Find a friend for every pet
games.petConnect.description: Match identical pets with a clear path of at most two turns. Paths may travel around the board. Clear all tiles in 180 seconds, with hints, shuffling and automatic saves.
games.petConnect.instructions: Same pets · At most two turns

games.carrot-fantasy.subtitle: Sky adventure · 12 original maps

games.brotato.subtitle: One potato. Six weapons. Twenty waves.

games.whackAMole.subtitle: Quick hands. Sharp eyes. Five rounds.
games.whackAMole.description: A nine-hole arcade challenge across five faster rounds. Hit moles, catch golden bonuses and avoid dynamite. Missing a regular mole or hitting dynamite costs a heart. Meet each round’s score target before time runs out. Touch, keyboard, pause and autosave supported.

Reach the round goal before the timer ends.
games.fruitNinja.name: Fruit Ninja
games.fruitNinja.subtitle: Every slice counts · Classic
games.fruitNinja.description: Drag your mouse or swipe to slice fruit. Slice three or more together for a combo bonus. Avoid bombs and do not miss three fruits. Waves get faster as you play.

games.puzzleBobble.subtitle: Bub & Bob · Classic bubble puzzler

games.puzzleBobble.hint: Match 3 · Tap to shoot · X to swap

Three community HD maps with original track data, nine increasingly challenging rounds, ball swapping, touch controls and autosave.
